top_signals.title: Kushner, Iger Buy Lakers for Record-Breaking $12.5 Billion
top_signals.summary: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger are buying the Los Angeles Lakers basketball team for a record-breaking price of $12.5 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. Randall Williams has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Singer Vehicle Founder on Louis Vuitton Partnership
top_signals.summary: In a groundbreaking collaboration, luxury fashion house Louis Vuitton and high-end automotive restoration company Singer have teamed up to create custom Porsche cars. This marks a first for both brands, as Louis Vuitton has never engaged in co-branding before, and Singer has not previously partnered on such a project. Rob Dickinson & Mazen Fawaz speak with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
